agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.2 to v0.4.3 without resetting. Stop all writers and back up D1, R2 and Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.42. Apply the listed missing migrations in filename order before serving traffic. Migrations 124_contact_email_proof_guard.sql and 126_restore_contact_erasure.sql bracket the immutable 125 backfill: the identical runtime erasure trigger must be restored by 126 before writers resume, including when 125 was already applied. Preserve owner credentials, native support history, permissions, imports and erasure fences. Older releases apply their intermediate migrations too: 125_contact_email_proof.sql changes only eligible unsigned widget contacts metadata_json to mark email_unproven=1; 129_owner_unassigned_alerts.sql enables is_notified_on_unassigned_activity for owners only where an active non-demo workspace has no alerted member. These documented migrations are intentional; every other original value is retained. Keep uncertain external outcomes without replay and retain human Send.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.3 qualifies fresh installation, README restore, reproducibility, delegation and upgrades from every published baseline, including v0.4.2. Native ticket statuses, priorities, groups, fields, saved views and previewed bulk updates are included. Back up and apply the listed missing migrations before serving traffic. Commands retain @runeditrun/rer 0.2.42. Hosted and paid-provider quality remain separately qualified; accessibility remains on owner HOLD. Production is separate and unchanged.
